The medal's icon illustrates it very well: as a Captain, you must successfully insert the authentication disk into the Nuclear Operatives' nuclear bomb. The 'nuke ops' aren't going to let you do that without a fight, so if you want this medal, then follow the medal description and 'show no fear in the face of battle'! You cannot obtain this medal by inserting the auth disk into a micronuke(or its defended variant), even though that bomb also accepts the disk. The admin-spawned 'event nukes' don't work either. Only full-sized ones from the Nuclear Emergency mode count!

You cannot get this medal on your own. An admin has to give it to you. This medal is typically bestowed on people who have made major contributions to the game, such as by fixing dozens of bugs or doing lots of re-sprites. As the Goonhub description puts it, thanks <3

Die via the suicide command; just enter suicide in the command bar/text parser at the bottom of your screen. The command offers a lot of different ways to die depending on what objects you're holding, what devices you're next to, and whether you're a human, cyborg, etc., and they all make you eligible for the medal, so just pick one you like. Just go through with it; if you use the command but cancel at the prompt, you won't get the medal, so merely entering the command isn't enough.

One unit, ten, hundred, doesn't matter how much. This can hurt quite a lot, so if you're not an antagonist, don't do this without a good reason. (If you are an antag, go right ahead.)

Die while handcuffed. Again, it doesn't matter how you die, so long as you didn't use the suicide command for it (which is somewhat of a shame since cuffs have a unique suicide.) Having shackles doesn't count for this, but zipties/plastic cuffs and silver handcuffs do, as do regular handcuffs, obviously. Since the code counts them as handcuffs, being duct-taped also works.
